settings.heading: Why We Created This Bedroom Art Series

settings.text:
A bed is more than furniture; it’s a cultural object that lives in the intimacy of your home. In “The Art of Rest” we place our designer beds inside re-imagined masterpieces, linking bedroom art to daily wellbeing. Each downloadable image shows how comfort, beauty, and storytelling unite in a single piece of sustainable craftsmanship.

Free high-resolution downloads: Use them as mood-board inspiration, wallpapers, or a gentle reminder that rest itself can be a work of art.

settings.title: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec · Whispers in Yellow
settings.text: Two figures rest on a Midsummer mattress, elevating Lautrec’s intimate Paris settings with refined upholstery and artisan details.

settings.title: Frida Kahlo · The Sacred Room
settings.text: Amid roses and symbolism, our bed becomes part of Kahlo’s inner world—a sanctuary for identity, beauty, and restorative sleep.

settings.title: Felice Casorati · Reading in Silence
settings.text: Architectural stillness meets soft elegance; the bed serves as a pedestal for focused calm.

settings.title: Henri Rousseau · Where Tigers Sleep
settings.text: A surreal landscape where even the wild find peace—showing how natural materials bring elemental comfort.

settings.title: William Morris · The Botanical Reverie
settings.text: A fox naps amid ornate flora, proving luxury can speak nature’s language.

settings.title: Pierre-Auguste Renoir · Impression at Rest
settings.text: Blooming greens, soft light, and effortless romance surround a bed built for generations.

settings.title: René Magritte · The Weight of Dreams
settings.text: Dreams feel weightless yet meaningful—mirroring the balanced support of natural fibre mattresses.

settings.title: David Hockney · Lines of Lightness
settings.text: Vivid geometry meets calming comfort; proof that modern art and heritage craft can coexist.
